item.title: Designing Interactive Audio
item.description:
I’m Jakob, a sound and interaction designer with a strong technical foundation. I focus on creating engaging interactive audio experiences, and on building the tools and systems that support them.

Check out my reel and portfolio section above, or visit Scripts & Audio Tools to see and download some of the tools I’ve build. Go to the about page if you are interested in learning more about my journey with audio, up to now.
